reply.emotion: warm and friendly, feeling happy and approachable
notes: Sonreír is an irregular verb that requires an accent mark on the í in many forms (like sonrío, sonríes) to keep the stress correct.
Do not confuse it with reír, which means to laugh out loud.

senses.definition: Hacer una expresión feliz con la boca sin emitir sonidos.

examples.text: Ella siempre sabe cómo hacerme sonreír cuando tengo un mal día.
examples.translation: She always knows how to make me smile when I have a bad day.
examples.emotion: grateful and comforted, appreciating a kind gesture from a close friend
